snippet.title: My Friends (DS game) gameplay - First 15 minutes
snippet.description:
For those who don't know, My Friends is a long forgotten DS game from Oxygen Studios where you create friends and do various playground themed minigames. You can also give your friends gifts to make them happy and eventually unlock new games or areas. Each of the minigames are themed around said areas such as the later ice rink having hockey.

The only proof of it's existence online is reviews and a small trailer. So, I thought I would record some footage. I do own the game, but ended up using a rom to play as who knows where my DS Lite is. Probably stolen idk.  Nevertheless, I think the best aspect is the character customization. Everything else is either decent or eh. I believe the customization was what interested me as a kid up until I got Soul Calibur where all my time proceeded to go into from then on. Don't blame young me.
